messages:
amy: Ran a host-side profile after the kernel-selection change. Small payloads (150-450B) show ~+3ms median on the ingress parse + tokenize path. Flamegraphs in gist: https://gist.github.com/fake/ingress-profile-3287
ben: saw p99 spikes on canary too. any quick breakdown of where the extra cycles are?
matt: quick samples indicate:
1.4ms parse_headers
0.8ms tokenize/utf8_norm
0.5ms kv_cache.lookup (miss)  # correlated with fragmented token boundaries
0.4ms http2_writev / grpc_frame_assemble
0.3ms kernel_select_lazy_compile
jordan: flamegraph link: https://gist.github.com/fake/ingress-profile-3287
sara: most of this traffic is http2 edge -> internal grpc translation. tiny payloads make parsing dominate CPU.
ben: micro-optimization note: smallwrite/hpack decode shows up in samples. tokenization boundaries crossing frames are causing more KV misses.
amy: I ran a quick AB: increasing coalesce window 1ms -> 2ms reduced median ~7% at low QPS but p99 regressed under bursty high QPS. naive bump not safe.
matt: suggests adaptive coalesce window based on instantaneous QPS and avg payload size. e.g. if qps < 300 and avg_payload < 512B => coalesce=2ms; else 1ms.
ben: also, kernel-selection is doing a lazy compile for some quant kernels on first batch, adding ~4ms. we should pre-warm kernels for pinned models on startup for Dedicated/Private.
jordan: I'll add a startup "touch kernels" job to precompile/pin kernels for pinned models.
sara: tokenizer heuristic idea: prefer prefix alignment so cacheable prefixes don't get split across frames. in sims this bumped KV hit rate ~10%. avoid splitting on emoji/ZWJ unless buffer > 32B.
amy: sketch of ingress config patch:
````
ingress:
  tokenizer:
    prefer_prefix_align: true
    min_buffer_for_split: 32
  coalesce:
    base_ms: 1
    adaptive: true
    qps_threshold: 300
    payload_threshold_bytes: 512
````
matt: caution: coalesce change affects batch shapes and kernel selector heuristics. we need integration perf tests to ensure the selector doesn't flip to a slower kernel under new batching patterns.
ben: plan of record:
- implement adaptive coalesce window at ingress (canary)
- runtime: kernel warm for pinned models at startup
- tokenizer: prefix-align heuristic tweak
- perf suite: http2->grpc small payload stream, KV cache hit rate, kernel-warm metric
I'll open PRs/tickets and a perf-suite job.
amy: I'll add eval prompts + a short job measuring end-to-end token latency and KV cache hit-rate. tagging @ben @matt @jordan.
ingest-bot: scheduled deploy: canary rollout ingress-adaptive-coalesce at 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z
ben: will shepherd the canary and watch kernel warm logs. ping if p99 moves up.
amy: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
